Chapter 7092: Divine Firmament’S Development

Chapter 7092: Divine Firmament’s Development

“Buzz.” Amidst tense conversations, Heavenrealm suddenly became tense as if sucked in place by something.

“Did you feel that?” Cultivators sensed this shift while living beings felt something strange.

Alas, it only lasted for a split second. Nonetheless, immortals pinpointed the phenomenon to Divine Firmament.

“Divine Firmament, right?” An immortal said.

“What’s going on there?” The discussion shifted from the apocalypse to the isolated world.

Despite being one of the nine major worlds, it remained isolated from the rest. Immortals occasionally visited, but only when invited or for other reasons.

“Bam!” They then heard a shattering noise blasting across Heavenrealm.

In the past, any destruction, including the death of a world, didn’t cause panic. In fact, immortals might come just to watch the show.

This even applied to Heaven Pit since it was limited to just Mortal World. Now, since they knew the apocalypse was coming, the slightest commotion instilled fear.

Thus, many hid in their fortresses and caves, not wanting to come out.

“Divine Firmament’s seal shattered.” News traveled quickly across the realms.

“Why is that? The divine beasts want to come out?” An immortal wondered.

“Why would they when the apocalypse is coming?” Another disagreed.

“The divine beasts are the oldest living race so in theory, they should know how to survive. Perhaps they have a different plan?” A primordial immortal said.

“Did you feel that tenseness earlier? Was that related to them?” Someone speculated.

“The seal didn’t break for no reason.” The primordial immortal was curious.

Immortals didn’t even care about the secrets and resources in Divine Firmament, only whether this could be a breakthrough for survival.

At the same time, Li Qiye on Heaven Essence Platform noticed and gazed into the deepest parts of Divine Firmament.

“What is this? Reactionary or another plan?” He murmured.

Those standing in Dusk Realm cared little about Divine Firmament.

“We have to go, take care of business and then do what we must.” Someone said.

Some of them bowed toward Li Qiye in respect. On the other hand, more just wanted to avoid getting any attention from him.

“The high heaven will target him first.” An immortal said after getting far away.

“Maybe he can stop it.” A golden immortal said.

“That would be best, but we have to stay far away from him. The flood will concentrate on him for certain.” The first said.

“If he attracts the majority of tribulations, the rest will get hit less.” The golden immortal said.

“We have to pay attention to his location and stay away.” Someone else said.

As for Li Qiye, he merely glanced at the high heaven and wasn’t surprised.

“Time to end this, let’s see who will be the impatient one.” He smirked.

Everyone had their own plan for the apocalypse. Li Qiye waited for a few special ones to make their move, but for now, he focused on the abyss revealed by the ocean’s disappearance.

The enforcer’s slash cut the abyss and continued onward, nearly severing Ruin into two. The closer, the more potent the slash’s remnant energy.
